mapper.sql: select pc.comment_id, pc.product_id, pc.user_id, pc.order_id, pc.parent_id, pc.content, pc.images, pc.score, pc.is_anonymous, pc.like_count, pc.reply_count, pc.status, pc.create_time, pc.update_time, u.nick_name, u.avatar, p.name as product_name, p.main_image as product_image, p.price as product_price from product_comment pc left join sys_user u on pc.user_id = u.user_id left join product p on pc.product_id = p.id
mapper.select: SELECT score, COUNT(*) as count FROM product_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND status = 1 GROUP BY score ORDER BY score DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) FROM product_comment WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND score IS NOT NULL AND status = 1
